caption: The drawing shows a ceramic object in the shape of a horse, rendered in brown tones with a glossy finish. The horse stands on a rectangular base and has a raised, curved tail attached to the right side. On the horse's back are two rounded reservoirs, one larger and one smaller, possibly intended to hold small items or liquids. The object is decorated with small yellowish spots and lines along the neck, back, and base, giving a dotted and linear pattern. The mane and facial features of the horse are textured and detailed, and the legs of the horse are integrated into the supporting base. The overall color composition consists of shades of brown, with accents of yellow and tan. The background is a plain off-white color, and the artist's signature "Carl Strehla" appears to the right and slightly below the object.
title: Pa. German Ceramic Horse
